# Ezzulddin Al-Sammarraie
> Telecommunications Engineer, Junior NOC, and DevOps / Systems Administrator based in Bucharest, Romania.

Digital portfolio and verified engineering proof-of-work for Ezzulddin. Specializes in Network Operations, WireGuard VPN monitoring, Linux systems, Go, Java, Bash scripting, containerized infrastructure (Docker), observability (Prometheus/Grafana/Alertmanager), and upstream open-source infrastructure development.

Verified open-source milestone: 11 upstream pull requests merged, including Canonical LXD #18852 and Kestra kestractl #165.

## Pinned Projects
- [VPN NOC Operations Lab](https://github.com/IzzaldinSamir/vpn-noc-operations-lab): Site-to-site WireGuard operations lab with Prometheus, Grafana, Alertmanager, a custom Go exporter, ICMP/TCP/HTTP/DNS probes, nine alert rules, four controlled failure drills, an L1/L2 runbook, and full CI integration testing.
- [OSS Order Fulfilment Lab](https://github.com/IzzaldinSamir/oss-order-fulfilment-lab): Telecom OSS service-order provisioning workflow in Java 21 featuring JDBC/PostgreSQL persistence, SOAP inventory integration, JUnit 5 test suite (74.9% coverage), Docker Compose, and L1/L2 operations runbook.
- [IoT NOC Monitoring Lab](https://github.com/IzzaldinSamir/iot-noc-monitoring-lab): Multi-container Docker Compose observability stack featuring Mosquitto MQTT, Prometheus, Grafana, Go-based TCP/HTTP health checks, and ITIL L2 Wireshark triage runbooks.
- [Portfolio Source Code](https://github.com/IzzaldinSamir/portfolio-site): Zero-framework, 100/100 Lighthouse performance portfolio deployed via Cloudflare Pages CI/CD.

## Featured Open-Source Contributions
- [Linux Foundation FabricOps #35](https://github.com/LF-Decentralized-Trust-labs/FabricOps/pull/35): Added YAML serialization support for fabricopsctl status CLI in Go (Shipped in v0.2.1).
- [Desktop Audio Engine limusic #58](https://github.com/SimoHypers/limusic/pull/58): Implemented cross-platform webview zoom scaling controls in Tauri (Merged).
- [Kubernetes Automation kprompt #113](https://github.com/kprompt/kprompt/pull/113): Implemented planner-level gatekeeper rejecting unsupported Kubernetes scale kinds in Go (Merged).
- [AI Infrastructure Canvas API #25](https://github.com/JohannsenLum/canvas-api-mcp/pull/25): Hardened HTTP error handling and prevented credential token leakage in Python (Merged).
- [Terminal UI LazyFTP #57](https://github.com/MawCeron/lazyftp/pull/57): Fixed visible row boundary calculation in terminal UI processes panel in Go (Merged).
- [SQL Engine go-mysql-server #3850](https://github.com/dolthub/go-mysql-server/pull/3850): Replaced runtime binary-collation name checks with explicit metadata and added regression coverage across the collation table (In Review).
- [Security CLI Engine NexGuard #67](https://github.com/jbrahy/nexguard/pull/67): Added scriptable JSON output to quarantine listings, including stable empty-array output and regression coverage (Merged).
- [Workflow Orchestration CLI kestractl #165](https://github.com/kestra-io/kestractl/pull/165): Added regression coverage locking bulk-update deletion to its safe opt-in default after the upstream behavior fix (Merged).
- [Template Tooling viber #12](https://github.com/abits/viber/pull/12): Hardened remote template archive loading against unsafe paths and oversized extraction, with regression coverage (Merged).
- [Canonical LXD #18852](https://github.com/canonical/lxd/pull/18852): Corrected operation-wait failure, timeout, and cancellation semantics across the LXD daemon and agent, with regression coverage across affected integration suites (Merged).
- [Canonical LXD #19078](https://github.com/canonical/lxd/pull/19078): Added regression coverage ensuring restricted project operators retain instance root-volume visibility when custom storage volumes are shared (In Review).
- [Canonical LXD #19083](https://github.com/canonical/lxd/pull/19083): Updated the VM guest agent to preserve existing template file permissions while retaining secure defaults for new files, with regression coverage for overwrite and create-only paths (In Review).
- [LibreDesk #452](https://github.com/abhinavxd/libredesk/pull/452): Scoped incoming HTML email content to a light canvas in dark mode using Vue and SCSS/Tailwind utilities, preserving inline sender colours and readability (Merged; shipped in v2.9.0-rc.8).
- [Media Extraction Engine #31](https://github.com/CuteTenshii/crunchyroll-downloader/pull/31): Rewrote memory allocation in Go to stream 7GB+ payloads directly to disk without OOM (Merged).
